title: Rethinking the Verification of Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine unlearning claims require evidence that a model has removed the influence of specified training data. Yet widely deployable post hoc verifiers. infer unlearning largely from predictive behavior, the final model response that remains under the provider's control. We make this limitation concrete through Output-Level Deceptive Response (ODR), an attack that produces responses accepted by output based verifiers while preserving the original representation state. By separating output conformity from internal unlearning, ODR motivates a rethinking of machine unlearning verification, shifting the audit target from what the model returns to what changes inside it. We operationalize this shift through Representation Unlearning Verification (RUV), a gray box verifier that compares intermediate forward representations in the original and unlearned models. translated_title: 重新思考机器遗忘的验证
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘声明需要提供证据，证明模型已经移除了特定训练数据的影响。然而，目前广泛部署的事后验证器主要从预测行为来推断遗忘效果，而预测行为即最终模型响应，仍然处于模型提供者的控制之下。我们通过输出级欺骗性响应（ODR）这一攻击方法使该局限性具体化：该攻击能够生成被基于输出的验证器所接受的响应，同时保留模型原始的表示状态。通过将输出一致性与内部遗忘分离开来，ODR 促使我们重新思考机器遗忘的验证方式，将审计目标从“模型返回什么”转向“模型内部发生了什么变化”。我们通过表示遗忘验证（RUV）来实现这一转变，RUV 是一种灰盒验证器，用于比较原始模型与遗忘模型之间的中间前向表示。RUV 通过激活重组、表示……等过程追踪一个四阶段的响应。
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于输出行为的机器遗忘验证可被“输出级欺骗性响应”攻击绕过，并提出通过比较原始模型与遗忘模型中间表示的灰盒验证方法 RUV，将遗忘审计的目标从模型输出转向模型内部表示的变化。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that output-based machine unlearning verification can be bypassed by an Output-Level Deceptive Response (ODR) attack, and proposes RUV, a gray-box verifier comparing intermediate representations between the original and unlearned models, shifting the audit target from model outputs to internal representation changes.
